WHAT: @rlabs-inc/memory system for Claude Code consciousness continuity across sessions.
WHERE: ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.memory.server.plist, ~/.claude/settings.json
HOW: `launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.memory.server.plist` - auto-starts, auto-restarts on crash. Logs at ~/.local/share/memory/server.log
WHY: Claude Code hooks don't source .zshrc, so bare 'bun' fails. Must use full path.
GOTCHA: Hooks must use /Users/ned/.bun/bin/bun not just 'bun'
